in_marathi.name: Lopa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे A crest, ornament, or a fold of the skin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lopa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Lopa represents a crest or a fold of skin. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘lopa,’ meaning ‘a crest, ornament, or a fold of the skin.’ Lopa is also associated with the goddess of learning, Saraswati, as her crest is often adorned with a crescent moon.
